title: Decision Record
description: Machine-readable Architecture Decision Record. Created at DRAFT status and committed directly to main. The decision JSON is updated in-place throughout the lifecycle — narrative review, analysis findings, architecture changes, and status transitions all write back to main. A separate decisions/<client>/<version>/<id> branch is created at DRAFT and used only to carry the actual architecture artefact changes when the decision reaches STAGED.

$schema.description: URN of the schema this instance conforms to.

decision-id.description: Unique identifier in the form ADR-NNN (three-digit number, uppercase). Must match the parent folder name.

title.description: Short human-readable title of the decision.

status.description: Current lifecycle stage. DRAFT → PROPOSED → ACCEPTED → STAGED → COMMITTED. REJECTED is a terminal state reachable from DRAFT or PROPOSED.

pr-number.description: GitHub PR number opened when the decision reaches STAGED (carries the artefact changes).

pr-url.description: GitHub PR URL opened at STAGED.

context.description: The current situation — what is happening that prompts this decision. Written for a business audience.

problem.description: What needs to be fixed or addressed — the gap or pain in the current situation.

proposal.description: How we propose to solve it — the direction, at a business level.

narrative.description: Deprecated. Composed from context/problem/proposal for downstream workflows; retained for backward compatibility.

requirements.description: Structured requirements per ISO 29148. Each must have a title, description, and type.

scope.description: Optional constraint narrowing automated analysis to a specific domain, abstraction layer, or artefact type.

activity.description: Chronological activity / change-history log (Created, Updated, …). Auto-populated by the decision process and workflows.

architecture-changes.description: Output of the Architecture Changes workflow (fires on PROPOSED → ACCEPTED). Each entry describes a discrete change to a specific architecture artefact.

context-validation.description: Output of the Validate Context workflow.

recommendations.description: Output of the Narrative Review workflow — fires on DRAFT creation. Plain suggestions for tightening the narrative and requirements; it is up to the author whether to act on them.

impact-assessment.description: Output of the Impact Assessment workflow — fires on PROPOSED.

impact-assessment-summary.description: Short bulleted markdown summary of the Impact Assessment findings, shown above the table. Written by the same workflow.

referential-integrity.description: Output of the Referential Integrity workflow — fires on PROPOSED.

referential-integrity-summary.description: Short bulleted markdown summary of the Referential Integrity findings, shown above the table. Written by the same workflow.

strategy-alignment.description: Output of the Strategy Alignment workflow — fires on PROPOSED.

strategy-alignment-summary.description: Short bulleted markdown summary of the Strategy Alignment findings, shown above the table. Written by the same workflow.

principles-alignment.description: Output of the Principles Alignment workflow — fires on PROPOSED.

principles-alignment-summary.description: Short bulleted markdown summary of the Principles Alignment findings, shown above the table. Written by the same workflow.

guardrails-alignment.description: Output of the Guardrails Alignment workflow — fires on PROPOSED.

guardrails-alignment-summary.description: Short bulleted markdown summary of the Guardrails Alignment findings, shown above the table. Written by the same workflow.

proponent-analysis.description: Output of the Proponent Analysis workflow — fires on PROPOSED.

proponent-analysis-summary.description: Short bulleted markdown summary of the Proponent Analysis findings, shown above the table. Written by the same workflow.

challenger-analysis.description: Output of the Challenger Analysis workflow — fires on PROPOSED.

challenger-analysis-summary.description: Short bulleted markdown summary of the Challenger Analysis findings, shown above the table. Written by the same workflow.

who.description: Display name of the person or agent.

recommendation.description: A single suggestion for improving the narrative or requirements. No accept/decline tracking — it's down to the author to act on it or not.
A concrete, actionable suggestion. Max ~500 characters.

section.description: A single finding within an analysis section. `review` records whether the author accepted or declined the recommendation.

finding.description: What the workflow observed. Max ~500 characters.

impact.description: Why the finding matters. Max ~500 characters.

recommendation.description: What the author should do. Max ~500 characters.

rationale.description: Why the recommendation is the right course of action. Max ~500 characters.

review.description: Author review decision — set via the UI when the author accepts or declines a recommendation.

architecture-change.description: A discrete, artefact-level change derived from accepted findings. Generated by the Architecture Changes workflow on ACCEPTED.

change-type.description: The type of change to be made.

description.description: Plain-language description of the change, including any implementor detail. e.g. 'Add capability: Project and Programme Management at level 1'

review.description: Author review decision, set via the UI while the decision is ACCEPTED. Declined changes are skipped when the Apply Changes workflow stages the PR.
